items.name: Bavarian Open 2023
items.information:
Wir freuen uns sehr darauf, euch bei den Bavarian Open 2023 begrüßen zu dürfen! Wir sind der größte Wettbewerb seit einigen Jahren in Bayern, und hoffen mit euch eine aufregendes Wochenende mit neuen Bestzeiten und Rekorden erleben zu können!

We are very excited to welcome you to the Bavarian Open 2023! We are the largest competition in Bavaria in several years and hope to experience an exciting weekend with you, filled with new personal bests and records!

items.name: Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGRTIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c5f8f952cf728dba362b73bdd07936acf8aab21d/0.png)

**Russian**

Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2023 - это ежегодный чемпионат Казахстана. За призовые места на данном чемпионате могут бороться только участники, представляющие Казахстан.

**Kazakh**

Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2023 - жыл сайын өтетін Қазақстан чемпионаты. Осы чемпионатта жүлделі орындарды тек Қазақстан үшін жарысатын қатысушылар ғана ала алады.

**English**

Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2023 is an annual national championship of Kazakhstan. Only the participants representing Kazakstan can compete for prizes at this competition.

items.name: Basauri Open 2023
items.information:
**IMPORTANTE** El Basauri Open vuelve a Basozelai, el lugar en el que se celebraron los campeonatos desde 2009 hasta 2017.
**GARRANTZITSUA** Basauri Open-a Basozelaira bueltatzen da, 2009tik 2017ra txapelketa ospatu zen lekura.
**IMPORTANT** The Basauri Open goes back to Basozelai, the venue that hosted the competition from 2009 to 2017.

![](https://i.imgur.com/FQKMkCv.jpg)

Los miembros de la **AES** recibirán un reembolso del 15% al concluir el campeonato.
**AES**-ko bazkideek %15-ko diru-itzulketa jasoko dute txapelketa amaitzean.
Members of the **AES** will receive a 15% refund at the end of the competition.

items.name: CubingUSA Rocky Mountain Championship 2023

venue.name: Colorado Convention Center
venue.details: On the first floor in the Four Seasons ballroom

items.information: We are excited to present the first CubingUSA Rocky Mountain Championship in Denver, Colorado for 2023! This comes following the recent recognition of the Rocky Mountains as an official CubingUSA region. Register to compete for the chance to be a Rocky Mountain champion and to experience the biggest event in cubing in the Rockies.

items.name: Uzbekistan Nationals 2023
items.information:
**Uzbek**

Ushbu musobaqa milliy chempionat hisoblanadi. Istalgan xohlovchilar qatnashishligi mumkin, lekin faqatgina O'zbekiston fuqarolari sovrinlarni qo'lga kiritishlari mumkin.

Iltimos, ro'yxatdan o'tishdan oldin hamma ma'lumotlarni diqqatlik bilan o'qib chiqing!

**English**

This competition is the National Championship of Uzbekistan. Anyone can participate, but only citizens of Uzbekistan can win prizes.

Please read all the information very carefully before registering.

**Russian**

Эти соревнования являются национальным чемпионатом. Участвовать может любой желающий, но только граждане Узбекистана могут выиграть призы.

Пожалуйста, перед регистрацией прочтите всю информацию очень внимательно.
